title: A tooth’s clues
hook: Fossil teeth can have different working edges.

knows: Animal teeth can vary in shape.
doesNotKnow: Distinguish a feeding hypothesis from a complete dietary claim.

misconception: One tooth shape proves an animal’s complete diet.
objective: Distinguish a feeding hypothesis from a complete dietary claim.

claims.text: Fossil teeth can have different working edges. A pointed tooth and a broad, worn tooth are found in two different theropod fossils. What can their different shapes support? The schematic contrasts a pointed tooth with a broad, worn edge. Tooth shape and wear can help scientists investigate feeding, but shape alone does not prove a complete diet or a behavior such as hunting together.
